Messages.Author: Ylly
Messages.Body:
I sometimes play similar deck with groups 2/3.
When I take a look at PRE as off-clan, there are usually 2 types of cards I consider: vote-helpers and Majesty.
The deck you built is not a dedicated political deck and your combat does not need Majesty. Summoning helps but this is not a heavy ally-deck either.

My deck runs many more political cards, besides Voter Capt. I also play Bew. Oration and 1-2 Awe.
I almost completely dropped combat (occasional Entombment, otherwise S:CE).

You may have a completely different plan that I may fail to see.

Messages.Author: Kimpan
Messages.Body:
Enticement? Do I miss something here or is it some other card?
A few pointers.
2 Zillas is never worth playing with, you can never count to have one when you need one. You either go crypt acc or you skip it, going semi crypt acc will just hurt you in the long run.
Elysium fields is a great card for Lasombra vote/bleed, and you don't have much stealth. But the look of your deck it looks more lika bruise/vote.

I guess you have a very heavy combat meta where you play.
I think your deck would have a much higher win rate if you switch out you combat for 5-8 SC and some more stealth, vote push, but I guess that is a different kind of deck.

National Coordinator of Sweden

Messages.Author: prestonp
Messages.Body: And, I don't really see the point of going to 8 S:CE and having more stealth and payload. At that point it's a bad Arika deck. Why have minions that have POT if you never use it? Just use minions who have no potence.

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:
Hey, Preston.

I believe that instead of the Scalpel Tongues you may want Iron Glares as they are more versatile, plus you don't have true wakes for the reactionary part of ST anyway.

Power Structure seems like a no-brainer.

Not a fan of the Abyssal Hunter but he couples well with Jake Washington.

No Grapples?

I'd like to see a little more intercept to help complement the Under Sieges, whether a location or a couple of transients, or both.
